log: Error: Invalid value: File does not exist: app.py
cause: The hosting entrypoint is app.py, but the supplied file is streamlit_app.py.
small_fix: Select streamlit_app.py at the student repository root.
check: Record the next build result and open the hosted URL; a saved log alone is not a deployment.

cause: The supplied manifest and uv.lock were not included beside the entrypoint.
small_fix: Restore pyproject.toml and uv.lock together at the repository root; do not add a second dependency route.
check: Inspect the dependency-install log, then run the app. If adding a real dependency later, use uv add and commit both files.

log: The requested interpreter resolved to Python 3.12, which is incompatible with requires-python >=3.13,<3.14
cause: The hosting Python selection differs from the class's selected minor version.
small_fix: Select Python 3.13 in hosting settings when creating the app; keep .python-version and pyproject.toml consistent.
check: Confirm Python 3.13 in the new build log and rerun local locked checks.

log: No workflow run appears for the pushed commit.
cause: The workflow was left at classes/06-deployment/.github/workflows inside a fork of the course repository.
small_fix: Use a separate student repository whose root contains the class contents, including .github/workflows/checks.yml.
check: Open Actions for the exact next commit; record the run and its result, separately from hosting.
